title: Outside general counsel interview
source_system: Interview (outside general counsel)
what_it_shows: Counsel's list of the record, notice and contract duties that reach company data (Produce Safety, Food Traceability, H-2A, WPS, PACA, Fla. Stat. 501.171, PCI DSS by contract, retail and grower contracts), brought together in one list for the first time

title: Other gap analysis interviews
source_system: Interviews (IT Director, HR Director, Security Manager, Director of Food Safety and Quality, Vice President of Grower Services, Controller, Communications Manager)
what_it_shows: Owners' descriptions of how each CSF outcome and record duty is carried out today; no established contact with the FBI field office or CISA; no pre-approved holding statements for growers and retail customers; the number of affected workers, growers and customers could not be estimated quickly without a data inventory; HR exports and payroll files sit in the productivity suite

title: Personnel file share permissions export
source_system: Productivity suite file share (SYS-03)
what_it_shows: The personnel file share is readable by 48 office accounts

title: Sensitive data scan of the personnel share and mailbox search
source_system: Productivity suite (SYS-03) data discovery
what_it_shows: 1,140 files with Social Security or passport numbers on the personnel share, which held H-2A passport and visa copies and was readable by 46 manager and office accounts on 2026-07-22; 64 payroll exports found in staff mailboxes

title: Firewall rule exports and review
source_system: Headquarters, packinghouse and cloud hub firewalls
what_it_shows: Rule bases exported for the headquarters and packinghouse IT/OT firewalls and the cloud hub; the cloud and headquarters rule bases deny by default, and the operations and Grower Services accounts route to each other only for the farm data hub API; a packinghouse rule allows any office host to reach the refrigeration and ripening controllers

title: Grower portal external review and TLS scan
source_system: Scanning tool run by the security analysts
what_it_shows: The grower portal and its APIs accept TLS 1.2 or higher only, with provider-managed certificates; the web application firewall applies managed rule sets and rate limits on the sign-in page; the portal publishes no security contact or vulnerability disclosure process

title: Gap analysis samples: Produce Safety, WPS and traceability records
source_system: SYS-01; packing line controllers; SYS-10; food safety files
owner: Director of Food Safety and Quality
what_it_shows: 30 harvest and field sanitation records from the 3 farms: required fields present, entries at Farms 1 and 2 made under shared crew logins, and Farm 1 entries from cellular dead zones keyed at day end from paper notes; 12 sampled weeks (2026-01 to 2026-06) of Food Safety Coordinator sign-offs, all signed; export of one month of Farm 1 records took 2 hours 40 minutes on 2026-07-17; 20 pesticide applications (2026-03 to 2026-05) entered in SYS-01 and posted on each farm's central board; 2 WPS requests in 2025 answered within 5 days; SYS-01 field map export with GPS boundaries for all 3 farms; 20 contract grower receiving tickets (2026-04) record grower and block but not the grower's field name or harvester contact; tally report records field, commodity, quantity and date; cooling records sit in the packinghouse controls; EDI advance ship notices carry lot codes, and 10 terminal market bills of lading (2026-05) have none; ERP keeps 7 years of shipping records and packing line lot data is kept 90 days on the controllers

title: Gap analysis samples: H-2A records, earnings statements and contact data
source_system: SYS-01 tally; time clocks; payroll service; HR system
what_it_shows: 25 H-2A workers' records for May 2026 pay periods: all required fields present, and 7 tally adjustments edited with no record of who changed them; 25 earnings statements: bilingual, with all 8 elements; no written procedure for issuing statements when SYS-01 or the payroll service is down; contact data for 25 H-2A workers: 9 have no email address

title: Gap analysis samples: settlements and bank detail changes
source_system: SYS-12 settlement runs; receiving tickets; grader reports; bank change requests
what_it_shows: 5 weekly settlements (2026-04 to 2026-05) reperformed: statements show pool prices, charges and pack-out by grade, receiving tickets segregate lots by grower, and grader output is not reconciled to packed cases; 10 bank detail change requests in 2026 were received by email

title: Gap analysis samples: vendor contracts and incidents
source_system: Contract register; service desk security queue
what_it_shows: 20 of 110 vendor contracts: 13 have no security or breach notice terms, and none has exit terms for data return, deletion or access removal; 10 of 22 incidents: each has triage notes, timestamps and a severity, chain of custody is informal, and lessons learned are not consistently recorded

title: Control assessment: Account management samples and interviews
source_system: Identity provider, SYS-01 (web and mobile), SCADA, and grower portal staff account exports; POL-02 (2024 and 2026 drafts); access review record (February 2026); samples: 25 of 214 terminations, 25 of 41 transfers, 25 new accounts; IT Director and Farm Manager interviews
what_it_shows: Samples of 25 of 214 terminations, 25 of 41 transfers and 25 new accounts: 9 of 25 sampled seasonal leavers kept an active SYS-01 mobile account more than 30 days after their last day; 8 of 25 transfers kept the prior farm's SYS-01 permissions; the 6 shared crew lead logins and the integrator's shared SCADA account have no named users; SCADA local accounts of 2 Irrigation Technicians who left in 2025 still exist; shared crew login passwords unchanged for 2 seasons and the integrator password unchanged since 2023; the HR feed notifies only the identity provider; the February 2026 review did not cover SCADA or SYS-01 mobile accounts

title: Control assessment: Privileged rights review
source_system: Privileged account list for all administrative planes (38 accounts); access broker configuration; SCADA server local group membership; IT Director and Director of Irrigation interviews
what_it_shows: All 38 privileged accounts reviewed: 18 hold standing administrator rights outside the cloud (6 directory, 4 SYS-01, 3 ERP, 4 SCADA engineer, and the integrator's shared account, which is a local administrator on both SCADA servers); any SCADA engineer account can change SCADA security settings

title: Control assessment: Remote access review and integrator session test
source_system: VPN configuration; remote access tool inventory on SCADA servers; pivot manufacturer cloud user list; POL-02 (2024); test of an integrator support session on 2026-08-12; SCADA integrator interview
what_it_shows: Usage restrictions are written for the staff VPN only; the integrator's remote tool runs always-on with one shared account and no MFA; there is no company authorization record for the integrator's tool or the pivot manufacturer's standing support access; implementation guidance exists for the staff VPN and for cloud administrator access through the broker

title: Control assessment: Training records and staff interviews
source_system: Training platform completion reports 2025-2026; phishing simulation reports (quarterly, latest 2026-06, 9.1% click rate); pre-season meeting agendas; 15 staff interviews (5 office, 5 crew leads, 5 Irrigation Technicians)
what_it_shows: Training completion reports 2025-2026 and quarterly phishing reports examined (latest 2026-06, 9.1% click rate); annual training reaches office users (96%) but not crew leads or Irrigation Technicians, who receive no security content at onboarding; 0 of 10 interviewed crew leads and Irrigation Technicians could name how to report a suspicious event

title: Control assessment: Logging configuration review
source_system: SIEM log source list; SCADA, HMI, and historian logging configuration; SYS-01 audit settings; MSSP onboarding documents; Security Manager interview
what_it_shows: Logged event types are set for IT systems only; none for SCADA, PLCs, HMIs, the pivot cloud, packinghouse controllers, SYS-01 record edits or settlement changes; SCADA audit logging is off and historian events are kept 90 days on the SCADA server; no written rationale for the event types, which are unchanged since the 2024 MSSP onboarding

title: Control assessment: Audit review and tally edit trace
source_system: MSSP monthly reports; SYS-01 audit trail; settlement service change log; SCADA alarm and event log; test: 20 tally edits from May 2026 traced in the SYS-01 audit trail
what_it_shows: No review records for SYS-01 audit records, SCADA operator and engineering events or settlement change logs; 7 of 20 traced May 2026 tally edits had no reason recorded and no review; MSSP monthly reports show review of IT alerts

title: Control assessment: Interconnection agreement review
source_system: Contract register; P02 information exchange table; pivot manufacturer, equipment dealer, refrigeration contractor, and grower gateway arrangements; Vice President of Grower Services interview
what_it_shows: 8 interconnections examined: interface characteristics are documented in the SSP and in the FMIS, ERP and payroll contracts; 4 (pivot manufacturer cloud, equipment dealer portal, 18 contract growers' sensor gateways, refrigeration contractor) have no agreement stating security requirements, controls or responsibilities; no privacy terms for the dealer portal (operator geolocation) or the grower gateways; no agreement states the impact level of exchanged information; agreements have no review cycle, and the FMIS agreement was last reviewed at signing in 2023

title: Control assessment: Baseline configuration review
source_system: Endpoint and cloud baselines; SCADA server, HMI, and PLC configuration records; grower portal build files; IT Director and SCADA integrator interviews
what_it_shows: Baselines documented and maintained for IT endpoints and cloud images; none for SCADA servers, HMIs, PLC configurations or the grower portal build, which are not under configuration control; the 2025-03 SCADA upgrade was installed with no baseline created or updated

title: Control assessment: Change control samples
source_system: IT change log 2025-07 to 2026-06 (sample of 10 changes); settlement service deployment history (10 production changes); SCADA and PLC change records (none found); fertigation recipe and ripening program files; Director of Irrigation, Packinghouse Manager, and development firm interviews
what_it_shows: 10 of 10 sampled IT changes approved and documented; all 10 settlement service production changes in 12 months deployed by the development firm with no company approval or security or processing-integrity impact analysis; no change records for PLC logic, HMI screens, fertigation recipes or ripening programs, and recipe changes are made directly at the skid or HMI; no alert when a PLC program or setpoint changes, and no after-the-fact review of OT changes

title: Control assessment: Benchmark configuration scan
source_system: Benchmark configuration scan of 10 randomly selected servers (2026-08-11); cloud guardrail and posture reports; SCADA server settings
what_it_shows: Benchmark scan of 10 randomly selected servers on 2026-08-11: 31% of settings deviated, with both SCADA servers among the highest at 48%; deviations are not documented or approved; settings exist for IT through the cloud benchmark and none for SCADA servers or HMIs, which run the integrator's default build

title: Control assessment: SCADA server software and services review
source_system: Installed software and listening services on both SCADA servers; firewall rule exports for the headquarters OT boundary; cloud workload service lists
what_it_shows: Both SCADA servers run a vendor remote access tool, a web browser and an email client; email, browsing and the integrator's remote software are not restricted on the SCADA servers; cloud workloads run only required services

title: Control assessment: OT inventory field count
source_system: IT asset inventory (EDR and MDM); OT and IoT inventory spreadsheet; installer invoices; field count at 12 sampled pump stations (2026-08-12)
what_it_shows: At 12 sampled pump stations, 41 of 118 devices found (35%) were not in the OT inventory, including 6 cellular modems; the OT inventory covers about 1,600 of about 2,900 devices (55%), records no firmware versions, owners or network locations, and has not been updated since the 2025 Farm 3 pivot installations; IT inventory is complete through EDR and mobile device management

title: Control assessment: Contingency plan review and interviews
source_system: IT disaster recovery plan (2024); BIA (P05); P08 runbook drafts; Farm 2 freeze-night practices; packinghouse downtime practices; interviews with the IT Director, Director of Irrigation, Farm 2 Farm Manager, Packinghouse Manager, and Vice President of Grower Services
what_it_shows: The 2024 IT disaster recovery plan covers SYS-02, SYS-03 and the cloud workloads and has no section for SCADA, PLC recovery, packinghouse controls, freeze protection or Grower Services; its recovery objectives predate the BIA; 4 of its 12 contacts are out of date; Farm Managers, the Packinghouse Manager and food safety staff do not hold it; it is not coordinated with incident handling or the food safety recall plan and has never been exercised; the Farm 2 manual night-start procedure is unwritten

title: Control assessment: Contingency testing review
source_system: Restore test log 2025-2026 (file services only); BIA RTOs; IT Director interview
what_it_shows: The restore test log for 2025 and 2026 lists file-service restores only; SCADA servers, PLC programs, the farm data hub and the grower portal have never been restore-tested; no test criteria, results or corrective actions exist

title: Control assessment: Backup review and restore test
source_system: Backup job reports for July 2026 (31 of 31 days successful); backup vault configuration; SCADA backup schedule and local storage device; PLC and HMI program inventory (68 programs); test: restore of one farm data hub table to the recovery network
what_it_shows: July 2026 backup job reports: 31 of 31 days successful; a test restore of one farm data hub table to the recovery network succeeded, and the write-once lock was confirmed; SCADA servers are backed up weekly to an unencrypted local device on the same network, with no verification or integrity check; 31 of 68 PLC and HMI programs exist only with the integrator

title: Control assessment: Recovery and reconstitution review
source_system: SCADA rebuild arrangements with the integrator; infrastructure templates for cloud workloads; IT Director and integrator interviews
what_it_shows: SCADA rebuild depends on the integrator's media and a support call, with no written procedure, and recovery within the 8-hour BIA RTO has not been demonstrated; reconstitution to a known state is not defined for SCADA, PLCs or the grower portal; cloud workloads have infrastructure templates

title: Control assessment: Identification and crew sign-in observation
source_system: SYS-01 user list; SCADA and HMI account lists; identity provider export; observation of crew sign-in at Farm 1 (2026-08-12)
what_it_shows: Crew leads at Farms 1 and 2 signed in with 6 shared SYS-01 logins during the 2026-08-12 observation at Farm 1; the integrator uses one shared SCADA account; 2 HMIs use a shared operator login; sessions in the identity provider, SYS-01 web and the cloud run under the signed-in user

title: Control assessment: Privileged MFA sign-in test
source_system: MFA sign-in test on 25 randomly selected privileged accounts of 38; SCADA engineer accounts; integrator account
what_it_shows: MFA sign-in test on 25 randomly selected of 38 privileged accounts: 21 required MFA; the 4 SCADA engineer accounts and the integrator's account did not

title: Control assessment: Authenticator and default credential tests
source_system: Password policy; vault records; default-credential test of 3 of 12 ripening room controllers, the cold storage refrigeration controller, and 10 of 46 pivot modems (2026-08-12, vendor-approved, outside operating hours); walkthrough of 12 pump stations
what_it_shows: Default administrator credentials were active on all 3 tested ripening room controllers, the cold storage refrigeration controller and 2 of 10 sampled pivot modems (read-only sign-in, vendor-approved, outside operating hours); SCADA operator passwords were written inside 3 of 12 sampled pump-station panels; shared crew and integrator account passwords are not changed when membership changes; the identity provider password policy and vault records match the written rules

title: Control assessment: Incident handling sample and escalation test
source_system: Incident queue (10 of 22 incidents sampled); MSSP runbook; 2024 IT incident plan; test: simulated impossible-travel sign-in on 2026-08-13 (MSSP called the Security Manager in 18 minutes); interviews with the Director of Irrigation and the Packinghouse Manager
what_it_shows: 10 of 22 incidents sampled: IT incidents were detected, analyzed and contained with the MSSP; lessons learned were recorded for 3 of 10; 2 (a pivot modem fault and an unexplained valve schedule change at Farm 1) were handled by irrigation staff without security involvement; no containment steps exist for OT, and SCADA at Farms 1 and 2 cannot be isolated without stopping irrigation; a simulated impossible-travel sign-in on 2026-08-13 was escalated by the MSSP to the Security Manager in 18 minutes

title: Control assessment: Incident response plan review
source_system: IT incident response plan (2024); P08 runbook drafts (2026-08); distribution list; Security Manager interview
what_it_shows: The 2024 IT incident response plan does not connect to crisis management, food safety or legal, does not address OT, product safety or the H-2A and grower data the company holds, has no response metrics and no provisions for sharing incident information with retail customers, growers or law enforcement; it is not distributed to Farm Managers, the Packinghouse Manager or the Director of Food Safety and Quality and has not been updated since 2024; the P08 runbook drafts (2026-08) add these topics

title: Control assessment: Nonlocal maintenance review and session test
source_system: Remote access tool logs on the SCADA servers; pivot manufacturer support access; refrigeration contractor visit records; test: an integrator support session on 2026-08-12 was started without approval and generated no alert
what_it_shows: Integrator and pivot manufacturer remote sessions are not approved per session, monitored or recorded; no nonlocal maintenance records are kept; integrator sessions have no MFA, and the tool and its network connection stay open after maintenance; an integrator session started on request on 2026-08-12 began without approval and generated no alert; the remote maintenance tools are listed in the draft SSP

title: Control assessment: Physical access walk-through of field OT
source_system: Badge system reports; key issue list; walkthrough of 12 of 54 pump stations, 3 fertigation skids, the IOC, and the packinghouse control room (2026-08-12)
what_it_shows: Walk-through of 12 of 54 pump stations, 3 fertigation skids, the IOC and the packinghouse control room on 2026-08-12: badge controls at the IOC and control room worked as listed; 8 of 12 pump stations had unlocked control panels and 2 had unlocked station doors; pump stations and skids share one common key, with 31 copies issued and 6 not accounted for; keys are not inventoried; the common key has never been changed, including after the 2 Irrigation Technician departures in 2025

title: Control assessment: Termination sample
source_system: Termination sample 25 of 214 (2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30); termination checklist; key issue list; badge system
what_it_shows: Termination sample of 25 of 214 (2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30): identity provider access disabled the same day for 25 of 25; SYS-01 mobile accounts stayed active more than 30 days for 9 of 25; badges for 3 of 25 and SCADA credentials for the 2 technician leavers were not revoked; pump-station keys were not returned by 4 of 25 leavers who held one

title: Control assessment: Risk assessment documents
source_system: Risk register and report (P01, 50 risks); BIA (P05); 2025 risk assessment; vCISO and Security Manager interviews
what_it_shows: The 2026 risk register and report (P01, 50 risks) follow SP 800-30 Rev. 1 and cover OT, Grower Services and AI; the BIA and the 2025 risk assessment were examined; the vCISO and Security Manager described the method

title: Control assessment: Vulnerability management review
source_system: Scan reports Q1-Q2 2026; 50 critical findings tracked to closure; penetration test report 2025-11; OT vulnerability records (none)
what_it_shows: Q1-Q2 2026 scan reports: 50 Critical findings tracked to closure, and 14 of them closed after the 30-day target, including an internet-facing VPN appliance finding at 41 days; OT components are not scanned or passively assessed, ICS advisories are not matched to OT assets, and no OT vulnerability records exist; the 2025-11 penetration test report was examined

title: Control assessment: Vendor file and contract review
source_system: Vendor files for 20 of 110 vendors; SOC 2 reports for 4 Tier 1 vendors; contracts for the SCADA integrator, pivot manufacturer, refrigeration contractor, development firm, and agronomy analytics vendor
what_it_shows: Vendor files for 20 of 110 vendors: 13 of 20 sampled contracts have no security terms, and the contracts for the 4 OT and code vendors set no security requirements; the agronomy analytics vendor's terms allow secondary use of company and grower data; the 2024 vendor procedure defines oversight at onboarding; vendor account roles in SCADA and the pivot cloud are not defined; 10 of 14 Tier 1 vendors have not been reassessed since onboarding

title: Control assessment: Developer testing review
source_system: Development contract; pipeline definition; unit test reports; penetration test report 2025-11 and retest 2026-01; development firm interview
what_it_shows: The development contract does not require the firm to develop or carry out a security or privacy assessment plan; testing is limited to unit tests, with no static analysis, dependency scanning or settlement regression tests; the 2025-11 penetration test and 2026-01 retest were examined

title: Control assessment: Boundary review, reachability test and passive capture
source_system: Firewall rule exports (headquarters, packinghouse, cloud hub) 2026-07-20; reachability test from the packinghouse office VLAN to the controller VLAN (2026-08-12); passive capture at the Farm 1 office; pivot modem connectivity
what_it_shows: Firewall rule exports (2026-07-20) examined; from the packinghouse office VLAN, a test host reached the refrigeration and ripening controllers on 2026-08-12; passive capture at the Farm 1 office showed office and pump-station devices on one network; pivot cellular modems and the integrator's remote tool connect to external networks without passing a company boundary device; traffic between office and OT networks at Farms 1 and 2 is not monitored

title: Control assessment: Patch and firmware review
source_system: Patch compliance report Q2 2026 (82% on time); SCADA and HMI patch history; PLC and pivot modem firmware versions (10 sampled)
what_it_shows: Patch compliance Q2 2026: 82% of IT patches on time, so 18% missed the 30-day target; SCADA servers and HMIs were last patched in 2025-03, 17 months behind; 2 HMIs run an unsupported operating system; PLC firmware has never been updated; 8 of 10 sampled pivot modems are 2 or more firmware versions behind

title: Control assessment: Malicious code protection tests
source_system: EDR policy export; test files on 5 laptops and 2 packinghouse line PCs; SCADA antivirus console
what_it_shows: Test files on 5 laptops were detected and quarantined within 5 minutes; on 2 packinghouse line PCs the test file was detected and not quarantined (detect-only mode); SCADA server antivirus signatures were 4 months old on 2026-08-12

title: Control assessment: Monitoring review and integrator session test
source_system: SIEM use cases and source list; MSSP reports; test: integrator remote session on 2026-08-12 (no alert); passive capture at Farm 1
what_it_shows: SIEM use cases, sources and MSSP reports cover IT systems; no monitoring sensors are deployed in OT networks; local connections to OT (USB, laptops at pump stations) and unauthorized connections in OT networks are not detected; the integrator's remote session on 2026-08-12 generated no alert

title: Control assessment: Supplier assessment review
source_system: Vendor tiering list (14 Tier 1); P09 vendor SOC 2 reviews; purchasing records
what_it_shows: Vendor tiering list (14 Tier 1), P09 vendor reviews and purchasing records: supply chain risks were assessed in 2026 for 4 of 14 Tier 1 vendors; the integrator, pivot manufacturer and refrigeration contractor have never been assessed
